title: Successful fixed-stage probe runs write a routine stderr line on every onboarding check
outcome: federation_probe_run writes its diagnostic only for failures, or for successful runs only above a stated latency threshold, so a long-running host does not write routine stderr lines for every onboarding identity or wake probe; the failure diagnostic (stage, typed cause, phase, elapsed, redacted detail) is unchanged.
acceptance: A successful fixed-stage probe under the threshold writes no stderr line, and a failure still writes its typed diagnostic; a focused test covers both.
The full gate is green and an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
